newsitem.title: UK: LPC - Nine banks bid for Bouygues Telecom loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Nine banks bid for Bouygues Telecom loan.

text.p: LONDON, April 22 (LPC) - Nine banks are currently bidding on a FF15 billion syndicated loan for Bouygues unit Bouygues Telecom, France's third GSM operator, according to a company official. Bouygues Telecom is seeking the credit to finance the continued development of its GSM network and also for working capital.
Up to four banks will be mandated next week to arrange the credit which will fully underwritten before it is launched into general syndication at the end of March.

Bouygues Telecom was awarded the third GSM license in October 1994 and began commercial operations in May 1996. The Bouygues network which currently serves Paris, Lyon and the south-east coast is expected to reach nationwide coverage by 1999.
France's two other GSM licenses are held by France Telecom and Generale des Eaux subsidiary, SFR.
Bouygues Telecom is a subsidary of the leading French construction and communications Group, Bouygues.
